title: Customer menu dark mode
objective: Give the customer-facing menu a dark mode with a visible light/dark toggle, defaulting to the visitor's system preference on first visit and remembering an explicit choice afterwards.
context:
NOT YET APPROVED and NOT implemented. Scoped for the first controlled real agent run.

What the Builder needs to know about this codebase:
- The customer menu is src/components/menu/MenuScreen.tsx. BOTH customer routes render it: '/' (src/routes/index.tsx, the public menu) and '/m' (src/routes/m.tsx, the secure bot-session link). Changing MenuScreen therefore changes both, which is intended.
- Tailwind v4 is configured with `@custom-variant dark (&:is(.dark *))` in src/styles.css, so dark styling applies to DESCENDANTS of an element carrying the `.dark` class. A `.dark` block already exists at the top of src/styles.css defining --background and --foreground.
- src/styles.css is SHARED by the customer menu, the staff dashboard and the owner console (the `--oc-*` block is the owner console design system). Add customer-menu dark tokens without altering existing staff or owner rules.
- src/routes/__root.tsx is deliberately OUT OF SCOPE: it is the shared document shell for staff and owner routes too. Apply the theme class on the customer menu's own container inside MenuScreen, not on <html>. A brief flash of the light theme before hydration is acceptable; changing the shared shell is not.
- Do not add a dependency. Everything needed (React, Tailwind v4, matchMedia, localStorage) is already present.
acceptanceCriteria: Dark mode applies to the customer menu ONLY — the screen rendered by src/components/menu/MenuScreen.tsx at '/' and '/m'.
A visible, labelled, keyboard-reachable light/dark toggle is present on the customer menu.
On a first visit with no stored preference, the theme follows the operating system setting via prefers-color-scheme.
An explicit choice by the visitor is persisted and still applies after a page reload.
Text and interactive elements meet WCAG AA contrast (4.5:1 body text, 3:1 large text and UI boundaries) in BOTH themes.
Ordering behaviour is unchanged: cart contents, the tp_cart localStorage entry, order-type selection, checkout and submission all behave exactly as before.
The staff dashboard is unchanged in behaviour and appearance.
The owner dashboard/console is unchanged in behaviour and appearance.
No API, Messenger, payment, n8n or Supabase behaviour changes — no file under src/lib/, api/ or src/routes/api.*.ts is modified.
No dependency changes: package.json, package-lock.json and bun.lock are untouched, and no new package is imported.
Nothing is committed, pushed, merged or deployed; the change is left in the worktree for a human to review.
npm run typecheck, npm run lint and npm run build all pass, with no new lint failure in any changed file.
stoppingRules: Stop if any change is needed outside allowedPaths.
Stop if any path in forbiddenPaths would be modified.
Stop if a staff or owner dashboard file would be modified.
Stop if any Messenger, ordering, payment, n8n or Supabase code path would change.
Stop if a new dependency would be required.
Stop if the shared document shell src/routes/__root.tsx would need to change.
Stop if the same check fails identically twice.
Stop and escalate as NEEDS_HUMAN after two revision rounds.
